units.source_text: 源氏对中将夕雾说：“如今我找到了这样的一个人。

en.t: Genji said to Lieutenant General Yugiri, "I have now found just such a person.

units.source_text: 你得好好地敬爱这位大姐姐。”

en.t: You must honor and cherish this elder sister properly."

units.source_text: 夕雾就去访问，对玉鬘说：“小弟愚不足道；

en.t: Yugiri then went to visit Tamakazura and said, "I am only a foolish younger brother, hardly worth mentioning;

units.source_text: 但请大姐知道您有这个兄弟。

en.t: but please, elder sister, know that you have this brother.

units.source_text: 倘有差遣，务请尽先使唤。

en.t: If you have any errand to give, please be sure to call on me first.

units.source_text: 前日乔迁之时，小弟未曾前来迎候，甚是失礼。”

en.t: When you moved the other day, I failed to come and welcome you, which was most discourteous of me."

units.source_text: 他说时像对真的长姐一般恭敬。

en.t: As he spoke, he was as respectful as if addressing a true elder sister.

units.source_text: 玉鬘身边知道实情的人，看了都觉得可笑。

en.t: Those around Tamakazura who knew the truth all found the sight amusing.
